fixes.root_cause: literal_target treated any `~` in a path as unresolvable. Windows 8.3 short names (C:\Users\RUNNER~1\AppData\Local\Temp) put `~` inside every absolute path on GitHub's Windows runner, so three irreversibility tests saw dynamic targets and the Windows CI job failed.
fixes.fix: Only a leading `~` is home expansion; an interior `~` is a literal path character. Regression test added.
fixes.tests: crates/leveler-execution/src/irreversibility.rs::an_interior_tilde_is_a_literal_path_character (red before the fix); Windows CI test job green on the released commit
fixes.affects_published: no - fixed before the v1.0.29 tag

known_issues: Release packages are not Apple-notarized or Microsoft-signed.
FullAccess is a documented user-authority boundary, not an OS guarantee.
On Windows, a confined shell can create a previously missing AGENTS.md or .leveler tree; the file is never admitted without approval, and existing protected objects keep their OS fences.

macOS local transport uses a Unix-domain socket. A project or HOME path longer than the platform SUN_LEN limit fails with a clear `path must be shorter than SUN_LEN` error instead of starting the TUI; the published binary passed acceptance from a short lab path.
There is no Linux ARM archive; the desktop client is built from source and is not part of this archive.
